title: Professional Marketing & Video Marketing Knowledge Pack

items.title: Marketing Fundamentals
items.description: Core marketing concepts: audience, value, channels, message, and measurement.
definitions: Marketing fundamentals are the foundational practices for attracting, converting, and retaining customers through researched audience needs and measurable campaigns.
Give AI Me a shared base for recommending any marketing strategy.
rules: Practice: Start with audience and offer clarity
Practice: One primary goal per campaign
Practice: Measure leading and lagging indicators
bestPractices: Start with audience and offer clarity
decisionRules: Follow: Start with audience and offer clarity
Follow: One primary goal per campaign
Follow: Measure leading and lagging indicators
recommendations: Start with audience and offer clarity
examples: Launch brief: awareness → consideration creative with one KPI
professionalStandards: Marketing fundamentals are the foundational practices for attracting, converting, and retaining customers through researched audience needs and measurable campaigns.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.description: Online channel mix: search, social, email, web, and paid media working together.
definitions: Digital marketing coordinates owned, earned, and paid digital channels to drive awareness, leads, and sales with trackable attribution.
Recommend coherent digital channel strategies for commercial video and content.
rules: Practice: Align creative to channel norms
decisionRules: Follow: Align creative to channel norms
troubleshooting: Avoid: Same creative on every channel
examples: YouTube awareness + Meta retargeting + email nurture
professionalStandards: Digital marketing coordinates owned, earned, and paid digital channels to drive awareness, leads, and sales with trackable attribution.

items.title: Product Marketing
items.description: Positioning, packaging messages, and go-to-market for a specific product.
definitions: Product marketing translates product capabilities into audience-relevant benefits, competitive positioning, and launch narratives.
Ensure creative and video present the right product story to the right buyer.
rules: Practice: Align sales and creative messaging
decisionRules: Follow: Align sales and creative messaging
examples: Feature → benefit matrix feeding demo video script
professionalStandards: Product marketing translates product capabilities into audience-relevant benefits, competitive positioning, and launch narratives.

items.title: Content Marketing
items.description: Creating valuable content that builds trust and demand over time.
definitions: Content marketing attracts and nurtures audiences by publishing useful, consistent content that supports brand authority and eventual conversion.
Guide long-form and series video strategies beyond single ads.
rules: Practice: Serve a real audience job
Practice: CTA soft until trust exists
decisionRules: Follow: Serve a real audience job
Follow: CTA soft until trust exists
troubleshooting: Avoid: Content with no distribution plan
examples: How-to series that warms leads into product demo CTAs
professionalStandards: Content marketing attracts and nurtures audiences by publishing useful, consistent content that supports brand authority and eventual conversion.

items.title: Video Marketing
items.description: Using video as a primary channel for awareness, education, and conversion.
definitions: Video marketing plans, produces, and distributes video assets mapped to funnel stages and platform behaviors.
Connect video creative choices to marketing outcomes.
rules: Practice: Map each video to a funnel job
bestPractices: Map each video to a funnel job
decisionRules: Follow: Map each video to a funnel job
troubleshooting: Avoid: One video for every stage
recommendations: Map each video to a funnel job
examples: Hook ad → demo retarget → testimonial closer
professionalStandards: Video marketing plans, produces, and distributes video assets mapped to funnel stages and platform behaviors.

items.title: Social Media Marketing
items.description: Campaign and creative strategy across social platforms (high-level; not platform-deep Step 8).
definitions: Social media marketing uses platform-native formats, community behaviors, and paid/organic mix to grow reach and conversion.
Frame social as a system without duplicating deep platform packs (Step 8).
rules: Practice: Test hooks separately from bodies
decisionRules: Follow: Test hooks separately from bodies
troubleshooting: Avoid: TV spots cropped for social
examples: Vertical hook variants testing 3 openings for same demo body
professionalStandards: Social media marketing uses platform-native formats, community behaviors, and paid/organic mix to grow reach and conversion.

items.title: Influencer Marketing
items.description: Partnering with creators for reach, trust transfer, and authentic product context.
definitions: Influencer marketing leverages creator credibility and audience fit to distribute product stories with negotiated creative control.
Recommend when creator-led video outperforms brand-only creative.
rules: Practice: Prioritize audience fit over vanity followers
Practice: Brief outcomes not scripts only
bestPractices: Prioritize audience fit over vanity followers
decisionRules: Follow: Prioritize audience fit over vanity followers
Follow: Brief outcomes not scripts only
recommendations: Prioritize audience fit over vanity followers
examples: Micro-influencer unboxing with unique discount code
professionalStandards: Influencer marketing leverages creator credibility and audience fit to distribute product stories with negotiated creative control.

items.title: Performance Marketing
items.description: Paid acquisition optimized to measurable actions (lead, purchase, install).
definitions: Performance marketing is accountable paid media focused on CPA/ROAS with rapid creative testing and funnel instrumentation.
Guide conversion-oriented video and offer creative.
examples: 3 hooks × 2 bodies × 2 CTAs multivariate test
professionalStandards: Performance marketing is accountable paid media focused on CPA/ROAS with rapid creative testing and funnel instrumentation.

items.title: Marketing Funnel
items.description: Stages from awareness to advocacy and the creative jobs at each stage.
definitions: The marketing funnel models progression through awareness, consideration, conversion, and loyalty—each needing different proof and CTA intensity.
Match video concepts to funnel stage instead of one-size creative.
rules: Practice: Increase proof deeper in funnel
decisionRules: Follow: Increase proof deeper in funnel
troubleshooting: Avoid: Hard sell to cold traffic
examples: TOF hook film → MOF demo → BOF offer + urgency
professionalStandards: The marketing funnel models progression through awareness, consideration, conversion, and loyalty—each needing different proof and CTA intensity.

items.title: Customer Journey
items.description: Marketing-stage journey mapping (distinct from narrative customer-journey in storytelling knowledge).
definitions: Marketing customer journey maps touchpoints and decisions from first attention to retention, guiding message sequence and channel choice.
Recommend journey-aware campaigns without duplicating storytelling narrative journey knowledge.
rules: Practice: Use video where attention is highest
bestPractices: Use video where attention is highest
decisionRules: Follow: Use video where attention is highest
recommendations: Use video where attention is highest
examples: Retarget cart abandoners with objection-handling demo
professionalStandards: Marketing customer journey maps touchpoints and decisions from first attention to retention, guiding message sequence and channel choice.

items.title: Lead Generation
items.description: Capturing qualified interest for sales or nurture.
definitions: Lead generation attracts and captures prospect information or intent signals through offers, content, and CTAs designed for qualification.
Connect video/content hooks to lead capture mechanisms.
troubleshooting: Avoid: Asking too much too soon
examples: Webinar signup CTA after educational video
professionalStandards: Lead generation attracts and captures prospect information or intent signals through offers, content, and CTAs designed for qualification.

items.title: Conversion Optimization
items.description: Improving the rate of desired actions through creative, offer, and UX tests.
definitions: Conversion optimization systematically tests messages, creative, offers, and paths to increase the percentage of visitors who take the target action.
Guide iterative improvement of video CTAs and landing alignment.
rules: Practice: Align ad promise to landing
decisionRules: Follow: Align ad promise to landing
examples: CTA copy test: Shop now vs See fit guide
professionalStandards: Conversion optimization systematically tests messages, creative, offers, and paths to increase the percentage of visitors who take the target action.

items.title: Hook Creation
items.description: Crafting the opening line/visual that earns the next seconds of attention.
definitions: Hook creation designs the initial pattern interrupt—visual, verbal, or textual—that stops scrolling and frames the promise.
Maximize thumb-stop and continuation rate.
rules: Practice: Align hook to body content
decisionRules: Follow: Align hook to body content
examples: ‘You’re wasting 4 hours a week on this…’ + messy desk visual
professionalStandards: Hook creation designs the initial pattern interrupt—visual, verbal, or textual—that stops scrolling and frames the promise.

items.title: First 3 Seconds Strategy
items.description: Deliberate plan for frames 0–3 where most drop-off happens on social.
definitions: First-3-seconds strategy prioritizes immediate clarity of audience, problem, or intrigue before brand ceremony.
Reduce early drop-off on paid and organic social video.
examples: Cold open problem visual before brand slate
professionalStandards: First-3-seconds strategy prioritizes immediate clarity of audience, problem, or intrigue before brand ceremony.

items.title: Audience Retention
items.description: Keeping viewers watching through pacing, open loops, and payoffs.
definitions: Audience retention craft uses curiosity loops, pattern variation, and timely payoffs to sustain watch time across the video.
Improve average view duration and completion for algorithm and persuasion.
rules: Practice: Open loops then pay off
decisionRules: Follow: Open loops then pay off
examples: ‘Stay for the third tip’ open loop paid off at 0:45
professionalStandards: Audience retention craft uses curiosity loops, pattern variation, and timely payoffs to sustain watch time across the video.

items.title: Product Demonstration
items.description: Showing the product working to create belief.
definitions: Product demonstration presents observable use or performance so viewers can verify claims visually.
Recommend demo structures for MOF video.
examples: Stain removal in one wipe with timer
professionalStandards: Product demonstration presents observable use or performance so viewers can verify claims visually.

items.title: Feature Presentation
items.description: Explaining what the product has in a scannable, visual way.
definitions: Feature presentation structures product attributes so they are understandable, ordered by importance, and visually indicated.
Support consideration content without dumping specs.
rules: Practice: Bridge each feature to a benefit
bestPractices: Bridge each feature to a benefit
decisionRules: Follow: Bridge each feature to a benefit
recommendations: Bridge each feature to a benefit
examples: Three icon callouts: battery, waterproof, sync
professionalStandards: Feature presentation structures product attributes so they are understandable, ordered by importance, and visually indicated.

items.title: Benefit Presentation
items.description: Showing outcomes and value the customer receives.
definitions: Benefit presentation translates features into customer outcomes—time saved, status, relief—made concrete in picture and copy.
Keep creative customer-centric.
examples: ‘More family time’ after automation demo
professionalStandards: Benefit presentation translates features into customer outcomes—time saved, status, relief—made concrete in picture and copy.

items.title: Call-To-Action Placement
items.description: Where CTAs appear in video timelines and frames (distinct from CTA strategy and storytelling CTA topics).
definitions: Video CTA placement decides timed and spatial positioning of asks—mid-roll, end card, lower-third—so action is visible and earned.
Recommend when/where to show CTAs in video without duplicating sales CTA strategy.
rules: Practice: End card always for conversion films
Practice: Soft mid-CTA on longer videos
bestPractices: End card always for conversion films
decisionRules: Follow: End card always for conversion films
Follow: Soft mid-CTA on longer videos
recommendations: End card always for conversion films
examples: Demo proof at 0:20; end card Shop now 3s hold
professionalStandards: Video CTA placement decides timed and spatial positioning of asks—mid-roll, end card, lower-third—so action is visible and earned.

items.title: Ending Strategy
items.description: How videos close for memory, branding, and action.
definitions: Ending strategy designs the final seconds—payoff, brand lockup, CTA, and emotional residue—so the video finishes with purpose.
Avoid weak endings that waste acquired attention.
rules: Practice: Hold long enough to read
decisionRules: Follow: Hold long enough to read
examples: Resolve story → logo → single CTA
professionalStandards: Ending strategy designs the final seconds—payoff, brand lockup, CTA, and emotional residue—so the video finishes with purpose.
